evidenceLimits: Prior thermal observations used the previous GUI 90C confirmation contract.
The thermal-interruption record is an observed interruption, not a stability PASS.
GPU NVML acceptance does not prove exact locked-range readback.
WMI acceptance does not prove independent firmware/fan ownership.
Stable quiet presets have offline replay evidence only; actual cooling and acoustics remain pending.
Product quiet candidate and bounded TZ01/DTT3 retention are replayed on the same observed temperatures; lower simulated fan levels do not prove counterfactual cooling or acoustic improvement.
Release authorization comes from the user request for habitual exact-target use; it is not a new physical qualification PASS.
Windows logon task and unattended acquisition must still be observed on the target; CI checks use zero-hardware fixtures.
Source-independent TZ01/DTT3 retention requires a target observation in Battery and during AC/Battery handoff; software checks do not prove battery cooling, runtime or acoustics.
Same-GUI explicit Automatic retry has software fixtures; current-target hardware retry has not yet been observed.
Configurable software handoffs and unattended resumption have software fixtures only; firmware thermal throttling, sensor integrity and unknown native-call exclusion are unchanged.
